## Exception handling
Set as the *Error Workflow* of the main pipeline (already wired via
`settings.errorWorkflow`). Any failed node routes here.

**Record to dead letter** persists the failure so the document is not
silently lost — `/metrics` exposes `dead_letter_open` for alerting and
`GET /dead-letter` is the requeue backlog.

Replace the NoOp with Slack/Email to also page a human.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ workflow_name: $json.workflow?.name || '', execution_id: String($json.execution?.id || ''), node_name: $json.execution?.lastNodeExecuted || '', error_message: $json.execution?.error?.message || 'unknown error', payload: { mode: $json.execution?.mode || '', url: $json.execution?.url || '', retry_of: $json.execution?.retryOf || null } }) }}
